title: Gypsumtools Black Friday 2025 Campaign
briefDescription: Comprehensive Black Friday campaign spanning website banners, social media content, email marketing sequence, and large-format print materials.
description: Gypsumtools required a full-scale Black Friday campaign to drive sales across their professional tool and materials range. This multi-channel project delivered a cohesive visual system across digital and print, with 14 daily product promotions supported by coordinated marketing assets.
challenge: Create a cohesive Black Friday campaign that would stand out in a crowded promotional period whilst maintaining Gypsumtools' professional brand positioning. The campaign needed to promote 14 different product deals across a two-week period, requiring a scalable system for daily social content.
solution: We developed three distinct creative concepts—'Industrial Impact' (bold, high-contrast workshop aesthetic), 'Precision Cuts' (clean, technical approach), and 'Toolbox Takeover' (dynamic, action-oriented)—allowing the client to choose the direction that best aligned with their audience. The selected concept was then rolled out across all channels: responsive website banners (desktop and mobile), a three-email sequence (pre-hype, featured products, launch), daily social media posts for 'Deal of the Day' promotions, animated in/out videos, and A1 print materials for trade counter display. We created a Canva bulk-creation system enabling the client to generate variations efficiently.
results: Desktop and mobile website banner suite
14 'Deal of the Day' social media post sets
Canva bulk-creation workflow for future campaigns
brandMessage: Coordinated multi-channel campaigns that transform seasonal promotions into memorable brand moments.
whatWeLearned: Building scalable systems (like Canva bulk-creation workflows) multiplies the value of creative work by enabling clients to generate variations independently. The three-concept approach ensured buy-in by demonstrating genuine strategic alternatives.
technicalDetails: Responsive web banner specifications (1920×527 desktop, 349×350 mobile)
Social media post templates (1080×1080 feed, story formats)
